scope: Comprehensive Status training-impact section response contract
checks_cover: Strict response/OpenAPI models for the report section and exact 15-field source view projection
Section and session rows match the enclosing location
Only verified/published lifecycle and source-defined session types are accepted
Session, distinct participant, hours, and mean improvement aggregates match the rows
Decimal half-even mean rounding matches the generator
Malformed fields/aggregates and the existing section-error response are handled safely
privacy_note: The source public view includes participant_name, trainer, and notes. This contract preserves current payload behavior but does not establish content privacy or approval for broader report audiences.
rollback: Revert the training-impact response models and location checks, focused route fixtures, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
